Clusters the 2024-03-22 hashtag pool at `RNA_snn_res.0.5` and splits it on Ptprc/Epcam into an epithelial and an immune object.

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The 2024-03-22-RNA samples were not enriched for epithelia.
We do this by doing FeaturePlots of Epcam (Epithelia) & Ptprc (Immune) & visually choosing which clusters have these features.

# Load Packages
```{r chunk-01}
pacman::p_load("Seurat", "dplyr")
```

# Load Data
```{r chunk-02}
# This is the direct output of htp pipeline on the 2024-03-22-RNA Samples
seu_obj <- readRDS("../../00-hashtag-pools/data/final-htp-seu-obj-2024-03-22-LongTerm.RDS")
```

# Analysis
## View Cells per sample
```{r chunk-03}
table(seu_obj$Sample_ID)
```

## Double Check QC Stats
```{r chunk-04}
seu_obj$percent.mt %>% max()
seu_obj$nFeature_RNA %>% max()
seu_obj$nFeature_RNA %>% min()
```

# Plots
```{r chunk-05}
create.dir <- function(dir_path) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) {
    dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

create.dir("../output/Separate-Epi-Immune-2024-03-22-RNA/plots")
create.dir("../output/Separate-Epi-Immune-2024-03-22-RNA/RDS")
```

## Plot UMAP (Epcam vs PTPRC)
Low Resolution UMAP
```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
a <- DimPlot(seu_obj, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", label = T)
b <- FeaturePlot(seu_obj, features = "Ptprc")
c <- FeaturePlot(seu_obj, features = "Epcam")
p <- a+b+c

pdf("../outputs/long-term-2024-03-22_Resolution_0.5-Ptprc-Epcam-FeaturePlots.pdf", width = 16, height = 4)
print(p)
dev.off()

print(p)

# Violin Plot
pdf("../outputs/long-term-2024-03-22_Resolution_0.5-Ptprc-Epcam-VlnPlots.pdf", width = 16, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(seu_obj, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", features = c("Ptprc", "Epcam"), assay = "RNA"))
dev.off()

print(VlnPlot(seu_obj, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", features = c("Ptprc", "Epcam"), assay = "RNA"))
```

# Separate Immune vs Epithelia
```{r chunk-06}
# Epi Clusters (Epcam)
epithelia_clusters <- c(3,4,5,9,20,22,27)

# Subset
seu_obj_long_term_epi <- subset(seu_obj, subset = RNA_snn_res.0.5 %in% epithelia_clusters)
seu_obj_long_term_immune <- subset(seu_obj, subset = RNA_snn_res.0.5 %in% epithelia_clusters, invert = T)

# Remove Seurat Clustering columns
seu_obj_long_term_epi@meta.data <- seu_obj_long_term_epi@meta.data %>%
  select(-starts_with("RNA_snn_res"), -seurat_clusters)

seu_obj_long_term_immune@meta.data <- seu_obj_long_term_immune@meta.data %>%
  select(-starts_with("RNA_snn_res"), -seurat_clusters)

# Save RDS
saveRDS(seu_obj_long_term_epi, "../outputs/long-term-2024-03-22_seu-obj-long-term-epithelia-2024-03-22-RNA-RNA_snn_res.0.5.RDS")
saveRDS(seu_obj_long_term_immune, "../outputs/long-term-2024-03-22_seu-obj-long-term-immune-2024-03-22-RNA-RNA_snn_res.0.5.RDS")
```
